How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for BHU Project Research Scientist-I (Medical) Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.bhu.ac.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 06-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the BHU Project Research Scientist-I (Medical) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the BHU Project Research Scientist-I (Medical) recruitment is 06-10-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS/BVSc/BDS degree from a recognized college as per the competent regulatory authority (NMC, DCI, etc.).

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Research Scientist-I (Medical) post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this position is 40 years, with age relaxation applicable for SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/EWS/PwD candidates.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Research Scientist-I (Medical) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 67,000/- per month, plus admissible House Rent Allowance (HRA).

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Project Research Scientist-I (Medical) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Research Scientist-I (Medical) post in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their application form to the official address.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the BHU Project Research Scientist-I (Medical) recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Written Test followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. Where is Banaras Hindu University located?
faq.answer: Banaras Hindu University is located in Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, with the pincode 221005.

faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is DEV/2026/NIRF BHU 2 PN(291026).
